_help: Key = the name exactly as written on the map. General fields (type, region, facts, image, text, lore) are shown in every era. Under "eras" you can add the same fields per era id (before-rogamon, rogamons-reign, after-rogamon, present) – they are shown when that era is selected. Era-specific type/title/image replace the general ones. Fields that still say TODO are hidden on the website – search the file for TODO to find what is left to write. Keys starting with _ (like the section markers) are ignored.

Hammerfall.text: The capital of Varland, on a height between two arms of the Endwasser, with the king's palace right above the waterfalls. On its temple square every god has a place.

before-rogamon.text: Founded at the same time as Beltheim; after a long rivalry it became the seat of the crown.

rogamons-reign.text: Resisted the necromancer for a long time, but fell through a trick. Generations later a still youthful Rogamon entered its throne room and declared his rule over the whole kingdom.

present.text: All of Varland's military power is gathered around the city while the outer provinces are left to fend for themselves.

after-rogamon.text: An opportunistic lord seizes the castle but is driven out; the lands are held for Rabenhorst until he returns. A town grows to keep training Paladins of the Good.

present.text: Also a relay for messages carried by ravens.

Winterglehn.text: The largest city of the continent, at the tip of the Expansion's coast where the Salt Road begins.

before-rogamon.text: (Old) Winterglehn – a rich city of the Expansion. One of its lords gathered children with necromantic gifts for cruel experiments; one of them was the boy who would call himself Rogamon.

rogamons-reign.text: Rogamon takes the city and declares himself king of Winterglehn and of the common people of Varland. From here he rules his realm of the dead.

after-rogamon.text:
Abandoned in year 0. Later rebuilt on the ruins of Old Winterglehn and soon rising to new greatness, fed by fertile soil, rich forests and the treasures still hidden in the ruins.

Centre of trade of the Expansion – and of crime and corruption. Theoretically anyone can get rich here; few do.

facts.Ruler: The last Lord of Winterglehn was Arnil Fang, though many would argue that the city was really ruled by Modyi, a shrewd businessman and mob-boss.

present.text: Mostly destroyed when Rogamon was brought back to life around year 225. Merchants and guild members who saved their goods now hold great power in the New Expansion.

Winters Ende.text: Home of the academy Ars Arkanum. The weave is especially strong here.

present.text: The grandmasters of the academy rule the region, regardless of the king's wishes.

Zweigheim.text: A city on both banks of the Siechlauf, joined by a great bridge that is also its market. Beneath it lies the Dark Harbour, a maze of tunnels.
